purpose: Resolve official-NFL-to-nflverse historical player identity variants deterministically without changing any source-quality threshold, football state, model architecture, or probability output.
supersedes_for_identity_resolution_only: the exact-name reverse-identity method exercised by PR #145
selection_basis: The v1 failure exposed identity aliases only. The v2 bridge is a generic source-identity rule chosen before any v2 qualification result: exact normalized aliases from nflverse's GSIS-keyed player master may resolve an official row only when exactly one alias-matched GSIS ID is also present in the canonical nflverse injury table for that same season, week, and team.

identity_rule.stage_1: Run the existing exact full-name / unique initial-surname matcher against same-season/week/team nflverse injury rows.
identity_rule.stage_2: Only for rows not uniquely resolved in stage 1, normalize the complete official player name with the existing LevLine name normalizer and look it up against the fixed nflverse player-master alias fields.
identity_rule.candidate_intersection: Intersect alias-matched GSIS IDs with GSIS IDs actually present in the canonical nflverse injury rows for the same season, week, and normalized team.
identity_rule.ambiguity_policy: If zero or more than one GSIS ID remains after same-team/week injury-presence intersection, keep the row unresolved/ambiguous and fail closed through the unchanged aggregate gate.
identity_rule.identity_only: The player master may supply identity aliases only. It may not supply availability, participation, lineup, injury, outcome, or forecast state.
